description: Semantic-path gold corpus (RFC-2026-02 Sprint 1). Each entry is a real public document chosen to stress one dimension of the semantic reflow path. Every case is scored by scripts/eval_semantic.py; the thresholds in `expect` are the RFC §4.3 / §9 targets, not the current measurements (which are recorded in `baseline` as they are taken).

categories.formula-dense: Display math dominates; the Typst math transpiler is the failure surface.
categories.complex-tables: Multi-column grids with numeric cells; the overlay path cannot rebuild these.
categories.two-column-figures: Two-column layout with floats; reading-order and caption pairing.
categories.long-mixed: Long document mixing all of the above plus references.
categories.toc-outline: Has a PDF bookmark tree; tests the outline-based TOC merge.
categories.no-outline: No bookmark tree; the Docling-only TOC path must still hold.

cases.title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models
cases.why: The reference paper for the RFC. 14 tables, 7 display formulas, 13 figures, 31 bookmarks. The run that exposed every defect in §1.

cases.title: Attention Is All You Need
cases.why: Small, dense math, universally known: a good first smoke test.

cases.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers
cases.why: Heavy table use for GLUE/SQuAD results; long appendix tables.

cases.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
cases.why: Two-column CV layout with many architecture tables and figures.

cases.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
cases.why: Very long (75 pages), table-heavy appendix, mixed content.

cases.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words
cases.why: Figure-first layout; caption pairing stress.

cases.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
cases.why: Derivation-heavy: long aligned equation chains.

cases.title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
cases.why: Dense math plus very large supplementary tables.

cases.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
cases.why: Figure-heavy multimodal layout.

cases.title: Training language models to follow instructions
cases.why: Long, annotation-heavy tables, mixed prose.

cases.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
cases.why: Long with many safety-evaluation tables.

cases.title: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision
cases.why: Wide result tables and audio figures.

cases.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
cases.why: Very large appendix result tables.

cases.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
cases.why: Figure-heavy generative layout.

cases.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
cases.why: Recent, equation-dense, algorithm blocks.

cases.title: Mixture of Experts (Mixtral of Experts)
cases.why: A second MoE paper: tests whether the fixed numeric rules generalise beyond the reference paper.

cases.title: RAFT: Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms for Optical Flow
cases.why: Algorithm-block heavy with multi-line equations.

cases.title: Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
cases.why: Pure-math paper: the hardest case for the LaTeX→Typst transpiler.

cases.title: Generative Adversarial Networks
cases.why: Short, minimal math, minimal tables: the lower bound case.

cases.title: Improving neural networks by preventing co-adaptation
cases.why: Older two-column style; different font and table conventions from modern arXiv.

targets.cjk_ratio: >= 0.55 (whole-document; the deliberate source keeps lower it)
targets.ledger.cjk_ratio_translatable: >= 0.55 (over only the blocks meant to be translated)

measured.note: Page/bookmark counts measured with pypdfium2 at corpus build time; categories corrected to match.
